info.name: Remit operator API
info.description:
API tests for the Remit operator API (api-service, `/api/v1`).

Run it against the state that `scripts/smoke-test.sh --reset --keep` leaves behind: the five sample files settled
plus the CHAOS01 batch whose only instruction is dead-lettered (see `docs/e2e-expectations.md`). The run can be
repeated against the same stack: the dead-letter replay requests adapt to the replay count they find.

Set `operatorPassword` and `adminPassword` in the environment (or pass `--env-var` to Newman). The collection
pre-request script logs in as both users with `pm.sendRequest` whenever a token is missing or older than
10 minutes (tokens live 15) and keeps them in the collection variables `operatorToken` and `adminToken`.
Requests use the operator token unless they override the auth with `{{adminToken}}`, no auth, or a forged token.

Five failed logins lock a username for 10 minutes, so the script never retries a refused login: after a 401
or 429 it stops logging in for 10 minutes (collection variable `loginBlockedUntil`, clear it after fixing
the password). Negative login tests use a username that does not exist.

Requests chain through collection variables (`acme093000BatchId`, `acme0003Key`, `deadLetterId`, ...), so run
the folders in order.
